## Classes

### <a name="unspamify"></a>`unspamify`

Implements the recommendations from https://github.com/Skyedra/UnspamifyUbuntu

#### Examples

#####

```puppet
include unspamify
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `unspamify` class:

* [`replace_ua_tools`](#-unspamify--replace_ua_tools)
* [`disable_esm_hook`](#-unspamify--disable_esm_hook)
* [`disable_motd_news`](#-unspamify--disable_motd_news)
* [`patch_apt_check`](#-unspamify--patch_apt_check)
* [`keep_distro_info`](#-unspamify--keep_distro_info)

##### <a name="-unspamify--replace_ua_tools"></a>`replace_ua_tools`

Data type: `Boolean`

Replace ubuntu-advantage-tools with the fake-ubuntu-advantage-tools stub
package, which removes the "Try Ubuntu Pro" APT messages. Also removes any
cached ESM announcement shown at login.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-unspamify--disable_esm_hook"></a>`disable_esm_hook`

Data type: `Boolean`

Remove the APT hook that tries to start apt-news.service and
esm-cache.service after ubuntu-advantage-tools is gone.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-unspamify--disable_motd_news"></a>`disable_motd_news`

Data type: `Boolean`

Set ENABLED=0 in /etc/default/motd-news to stop dynamic MOTD ads.
Installs motd-news-config, which owns that file.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-unspamify--patch_apt_check"></a>`patch_apt_check`

Data type: `Boolean`

Patch /usr/lib/update-notifier/apt_check.py so it no longer prints the
"ESM Apps is not enabled" messages at login. Opt-in, because it edits a
file owned by update-notifier-common.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-unspamify--keep_distro_info"></a>`keep_distro_info`

Data type: `Boolean`

Install distro-info and mark it manually installed. ubuntu-advantage-tools
was the only package depending on it, so apt would otherwise offer to
autoremove it.

Default value: `false`
